body: STAB-2: the two named files alone CANNOT make the suite green, and one of them regresses a truth claim. (1) docs/runs/README.md row added -> test_run_archive_index_lists_every_report and both wire_docs tests now PASS. (2) test_run_archive_integrity_standard_matches_practice reads the LEDGER file, not the index: it requires docs/runs/2026-09-20-clean-sweep-tracker.md to itself match /integrity inventory[^.]*retained/ (09-14 precedent line: 'Run-close integrity inventory: retained inline in the Final report section at close'). That file is a declared non-goal, so the test stays RED without a one-line honest addition to it. (3) Running wire_docs.py rewrites README.md's proof-ladder alt text BACK to 'today every mission reads doctrine-only' -- a false claim that commit 3833c88e hand-repaired to 'clean-sweep and prove-it read self-run'. The stale string is hardcoded at assets/diagrams/generator/wire_docs.py:27; editing the script is a declared non-goal, and the diagram regen is open issue #434. Committing the script's output makes README.md contradict docs/runs/README.md. Which option?
